title: The Persevering Church
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The persevering church is the people of God kept by Christ through suffering, weakness, opposition, persecution, and time until He returns. Christ preserves His church and calls His people to endure faithfully.
summary: The persevering church is the people of God kept by Christ through suffering, weakness, opposition, persecution, and time until He returns. Christ preserves His church and calls His people to endure faithfully.
christFocus: Jesus Christ promised to build His church, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it. He walks among His churches, corrects them, strengthens them, and will bring His people safely to glory.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The church has always faced weakness, opposition, persecution, false teaching, internal sin, and cultural pressure. Yet Christ promises that He will build His church and that His saving purpose will not fail.

Perseverance does not mean every local church remains faithful forever. Revelation shows Christ warning and correcting churches. Some may lose their lampstand if they refuse repentance.

Still, Christ preserves His people. He calls churches to faithfulness, endurance, repentance, love, truth, and courage. The persevering church overcomes not by worldly power, but by faithfulness to the Lord.

The church’s endurance is tied to future hope. Christ will return, judge evil, reward faithfulness, and bring His people into everlasting glory.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Believers can become discouraged when the church looks weak, divided, persecuted, or compromised. This doctrine reminds them that Christ has not lost control of His church.

It also warns against presumption. Perseverance is not a reason for laziness or compromise. Churches must listen to Christ, repent when corrected, and remain faithful under pressure.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Do not lose hope when the church looks weak, and do not become careless because Christ is faithful. Pray for your church to endure in truth, love, holiness, and mission. Keep your eyes on Jesus, who builds, corrects, preserves, and will finally gather His people in glory.
